message:
Propose 2 or 3 scenarios. Reply with {"scenarios": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill.
- ids "A", "B", "C". "changes" reference node ids from "affected" ({"node", "set"} or {"node", "replace_with"}).
- burdens: one entry per affected group, "group" = the group id, "people" = its size, "minutes" = your estimate of time lost per person.
- "capacity" = capacity of the venue used in that scenario (null if unknown), "attendees" = the attendees group size.
- "extra_cost_eur": null when unknown. List every unverified fact in "to_confirm". Do not rank.
- "accessibility_ok" and "within_opening_hours" mean "not known to fail": set them to false ONLY when a source says the scenario fails that requirement. If unknown, keep true and add it to "to_confirm".

I have the contract. Now I'll build three scenarios. Key facts: the main hall (capacity 220) is lost; the attendee group is 200; candidates are only "to confirm" for availability and price. Since candidates have capacity 250 (or unknown for NEWCAP), I'll use a candidate venue in each scenario and keep the time shifts consistent with the affected nodes. Venue-specific details are unverified, so they go in `to_confirm`.

Scenario designs:
- **A**: Move to Salon Jouffroy (capacity 250), keep all times; the AV setup and volunteer meet-up move to the new venue and catering moves with it. Travel for attendees is the main burden.
- **B**: Move to Espace Mont Louis (capacity 250), same times.
- **C**: Move to NEWCAP Event Center (capacity unknown, null), same times.

The burden for each group reflects travel between the original and new location; I'll estimate it as an estimate with `must_replan: false`. Workshop participants and speakers are affected only if the room changes, so I'll include them.
